title: Measurement Schema
description: Bathroom measurement data: room boundary, walls, openings, complete measurement points, service points, and height parameters.

schemaVersion.description: Schema semantic version. Must match the version in $id.

roomId.description: Stable UUID for this room measurement. Uniquely identifies this room across the project lifecycle.

boundary.description: Ordered 2D points defining the room boundary polygon on the finished floor plane. Points are listed counterclockwise. Coordinates in millimeters (integer).

walls.description: Wall segments forming the room perimeter. Must match boundary edges 1:1.

openings.description: Door and window openings in walls. Optional — an empty room may have no openings recorded.

drainagePoints.description: Floor drain locations. Optional — a room without floor drains is valid (e.g. powder room).

pipeEnclosures.description: Pipe shaft / enclosure areas that reduce usable floor space. Optional — rooms without pipe enclosures are valid.

waterSupplyPoints.description: Water supply connection points (cold/hot). Optional — a room without water supply points is valid (e.g. storage).

measurementPoints.description: Complete, lossless point collection used for round-tripping every supported point type. The service-specific arrays remain for compatibility.

Point2D.description: A 2D point in the finished-floor coordinate system. X = horizontal (increasing right), Y = depth (increasing inward). Unit: mm (integer).

HeightParams.description: Height-related parameters. All values in millimeters (integer). These are distinct concepts — do not conflate them.

roomHeight.description: room.height: finished-floor to finished-ceiling height of the room (净高 / net ceiling height).

groundElevation.description: 地面标高: elevation of the finished floor relative to the building reference level. Can be negative (below reference).

wallHeight.description: 墙高: total wall height from finished floor to structural ceiling (before any dropped ceiling). >= roomHeight when a dropped ceiling is present.

netHeight.description: 净高: net usable height. Same as roomHeight unless there are obstructions (beams, soffits) that reduce it locally. Optional — defaults to roomHeight when absent.

doorOpeningHeight.description: 门洞高度: height of door openings from finished floor to top of rough opening. Optional — defaults to scenario-dependent values (usually wallHeight) when absent.

WallSegment.description: A wall segment along one edge of the room boundary.

Opening.description: A door or window opening in a wall.

wallIndex.description: Index into the walls array identifying which wall this opening belongs to.

position.description: Center point of the opening on the finished floor plane.

height.description: Opening height in millimeters (finished floor to top of opening).

type.description: Opening type: door, window, or open passage.

sillHeight.description: Sill height above finished floor in mm. Required for windows, optional for doors (defaults to 0).

swingDirection.description: Door swing direction as viewed from inside the room. 'none' for passages and windows.

swingOpening.description: Whether the door swings into or out of the room. Required when type=door.

DrainagePoint.description: A floor drain or drainage connection point.

drainId.description: Stable UUID for this drainage point.

position.description: Center of the drain on the finished floor plane.

PipeEnclosure.description: A pipe shaft or enclosure area. These are obstructions — non-load-bearing enclosed spaces for pipes.

enclosureId.description: Stable UUID for this pipe enclosure.

boundary.description: 2D polygon bounding the pipe enclosure on the finished floor plane. Counterclockwise order.

isAccessible.description: Whether this enclosure has an access panel for maintenance.

containsDrain.description: Whether this enclosure contains a drainage pipe. True means it may affect drainage routing decisions.

supplyId.description: Stable UUID for this water supply point.

position.description: Position of the supply outlet on the finished floor plane.

heightAboveFloor.description: Height of the supply outlet center above finished floor in mm.

MeasurementPoint.description: A typed measured point or fixed fixture in the room.
